Pin Location Assignment.description: Assigns a physical FPGA pin to a top-level port

Pin I/O Standard Assignment.description: Sets the I/O electrical standard for a port pin

Source File Assignment.description: Adds a HDL source file or constraints file to the compilation hierarchy

Pin Current Strength.description: Specifies current strength config for an output pin

Pin Weak Pull-Up.description: Enables or disables the internal weak pull-up resistor

Global Timing Constraints SDC.description: Includes a Synopsys Design Constraints file
